text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: inference-serving-prod high-5xx rate detected in us-west-2, paging SRE oncall

oncall-bot: pager context: increased 5xx from 0.2% -> ~12% over last 3 mins; p50 latency stable. Error logs show kvcache misses and `rpc: connection reset` to kvstore-42

sam.k: i'm on it. looking at the frontend and runtime metrics now. any obvious deploys?

elaine: not seeing deploys in last 20m. autoscaler did a small scale up 12m ago.

sam.k: ok grabbing tail of logs. suspecting kvcache eviction thrash. dumping recent logs:```
[2028-10-04 16:12:03] ERROR runtime: async request failed: rpc: conn reset by peer
[2028-10-04 16:12:04] WARN kvcache: miss spike keyspace=prefix-qa size=128
[2028-10-04 16:12:05] ERROR http: 502 upstream read timeout
```

marco: i'm toggling route policy to fallback model-variant lower-memory to see if KV load drops. switching to canary route now.

sam.k: thanks. also increasing request-level retry budget to avoid cascades.

monica: customer-impact callout: one enterprise tenant reported degraded responses ~16:12 PDT, about 120 requests/min affected. CC @product-ops

product-ops: noted. logging for sales + support. need an estimated MTTx and public status?

sam.k: mitigation in progress: rolled routing to variant-b which uses async local cache and reduces kvstore pressure. latency p95 jumped transiently but 5xx dropped to ~1.1% after 2m.

oncall-bot: action: page resolved? Please ack.

sam.k: ack. marking page resolved. leaving notes for handoff.

elaine: can we capture the exact KV eviction pattern for the postmortem? looks like TTL churn and a config mismatch in cache size.

marco: i captured kvstore metrics and a heapprofile. attaching snippet in logs channel. we should schedule a short post-incident review (PIR) to determine whether we need different eviction policy or tweak batching.

sam.k: leaving handoff to next shift. key points: root cause likely kvcache misconfiguration + autoscaler thrash; mitigation: route to variant-b fallback + increased retry budget. impact: approx 20 minutes of elevated 5xx, one enterprise tenant had errors for ~8 mins.

sre-lead: thanks. please open action items and size them. i'll own postmortem scheduling.

monica: creating action list now, propose owners and S/M/L sizing: 1) Investigate KV eviction cause and telemetry gaps (owner: marco, size: M) 2) Add emergency routing playbook and a runbook snippet for variant-fallback (owner: sam.k, size: S) 3) Add metric alert for kv eviction rates crossing 5% (owner: elaine, size: S) 4) Evaluate autoscaler config to avoid thrash under KV pressure (owner: infra-squad, size: L) 5) Customer comms follow-up and timeline (owner: product-ops, size: S)

product-ops: prioritization: severity P2 for roadmap fit; but customer impact requires comms in next 24h. mark items 1 and 4 as quarterly Q4 roadmap candidates if the fix requires infra changes.

marco: for item 1, I ran an initial query: eviction_count spiked from 30/min -> 1800/min at incident peak. seems tied to a TTL reset code path in model shard loader.

sam.k: adding runbook snippet to repo now:```
steps:
  - check kv eviction rate: metrics.kv.evictions.rate
  - if > 500/min, route to variant-b and raise retries
  - notify infra and run heap dump
```

elaine: i'll add alert and a Grafana dashboard panel for the new metric. tagging infra-squad for autoscaler review. @infra-squad please take a look at autoscaler hysteresis config.

sre-lead: for the postmortem: i'm scheduling PIR for tomorrow 15:00 PT. agenda: timeline, root cause analysis, action item assignment & owners, risk/mitigation plan, QA verification. sam.k and marco to present.

monica: created a postmortem draft in drive: https://drive.internal/reports/pir-2080456789 - please add notes. also created tracker issue: https://issues.internal/PI-2981

product-ops: product impacted customer list and comms draft in the doc. recommend sending a brief update today stating incident resolved and follow-up scheduled.

sam.k: i'll prepare short timeline and the logs we collected. marco will include kv metrics.

marco: estimating work sizing: item 1 (root cause fix) might be L if it requires code changes to shard loader; initial debug is M. will refine after triage.

sre-lead: prioritization rubric: any item that reduces customer visible 5xx gets P0/P1. Others go into Q4 planning with clear acceptance criteria.

monica: action items summary (copying into issue):
 - PI-2981-1 Investigate KV eviction codepath + patch if needed (owner: marco) size: M->L (depends) priority: P1
 - PI-2981-2 Runbook: emergency variant fallback and retry knobs (owner: sam.k) size: S priority: P0
 - PI-2981-3 Alerting: eviction-rate alert + dashboard (owner: elaine) size: S priority: P0
 - PI-2981-4 Autoscaler config review and tests (owner: infra-squad) size: L priority: P1 -> Q4 roadmap candidate
 - PI-2981-5 Customer comms and postmortem summary (owner: product-ops) size: S priority: P0

product-ops: i'll send the communication after sam/marco drop timeline items.

oncall-bot: reminder: please close the thread after PIR and mark actions with due dates.

sam.k: ack. will post updates in the tracker. thanks team. :thumbsup:

sre-lead: closing notes: good mitigation flow — improved routing worked. main follow-ups are telemetry + autoscaler safety. we'll update quarterly priorities in next planning sync.
